text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a veritable maelstrom of fervor and excitement, the curtain falls on the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The entire crowd celebrates the moment that <chrname> is crowned the greatest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: What an electric atmosphere. Everyone's cheering for you two!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I have to hear your thoughts! How does it feel to see your partner crowned as the greatest?!
choice_data_list: Even if I was the only spectator here…
Even if I was the only spectator here…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: I would still confidently declare that my partner was the greatest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Umm, but… The myriad spectators here in the stands are praising your achievement.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: They're precisely why your partner is being recognized and celebrated as the greatest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Even I think… that she's the fastest…
choice_data_list: You don't truly mean that, do you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh? O-of course I do. The Twinkle Star Climax was a massive success and—
choice_data_list: You believe in the Umamusume who's greatest in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …The greatest in my heart?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're too slow, Etsie! Hurry up or I'll leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I win!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but think that if my childhood friend had entered the Climax, she would have won the most points.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Even though a different Umamusume was crowned the greatest and is being lauded by this huge crowd… deep down, I wanted my friend to win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Boy, today's race was phenomenal!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I wonder what the next Climax will be like. I bet there are gonna be loads of challengers eager to take the crown.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I'm already excited! I hope my fave runs in the next Climax!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Watching her become crowned the greatest from the stands would be like a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A dream…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …Perhaps my dream has been alive all this time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ever since the day I lost that race, I feel like I've been chasing after my friend—chasing my dream.
choice_data_list: Maybe there are as many "greatest" Umamusume as there are dreams.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: …You might be right. Everyone places their hopes on the shoulders of the Umamusume they believe in.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: However! For today at least, the title of "greatest" belongs to only one Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer <username>! Please say a few words for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus, in both name and reality, <chrname> becomes the greatest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The proof of her strength gleams brilliantly, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, even if there was no trophy, nor any spectators in the stands…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I would never stop believing in my dream—never stop believing that she's the greatest.
